name: Hotel Innsbruck
beschreibung: Hotel Innsbruck enjoys a prime location along the Inn River right beside Innsbruck's historic Old Town. The hotel harmoniously unites contemporary urban elegance with authentic alpine ambiance. The nearby Hungerburgbahn funicular provides immediate access to the peaks of the Nordkette. Ski areas such as Patscherkofel, Axamer Lizum, and the Stubai Glacier are effortlessly reached in winter. Amenities feature a luxury spa area with an indoor pool, diverse saunas, and fine dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Innsbruck in the heart of the Tyrolean capital combines urban luxury, an indoor pool and spa wellness area, fine dining, and direct links to the Nordkette cable car.
